chunks: And from him, from Ibn Abi Hamzah, from Ibn Muskān, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū 'Abdillāh (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Mighty: 'And direct your faces toward every mosque.' He said: 'This is also the Qiblah.'

key_terms.وَأَقِيمُوا وُجُوهَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ مَس: And direct your faces toward every mosque (Quranic verse)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'direct your faces toward every mosque' in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sādiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the Quranic command to 'direct your faces toward every mosque' (2:144) refers to the Qiblah itself, affirming the validity of facing the Kaaba from any mosque. This is contextualized by the historical shift in Qiblah direction, which occurred after the Battle of Badr, marking the transition from Jerusalem to Mecca as the focal point of Islamic prayer.
